meta.title: Order Activity records a vendor revising a bid
gaps: Verify the exact vendor identity recorded for the revision.
Verify the exact date and time recorded for the revision.
Verify that no earlier activity is missing and that all activity entries are in chronological order.

plan.title: Order Activity records vendor bid revision

steps.note: Start a buyer-side event for the activity test.
Use an RFQ stage because the case concerns a vendor bid and revision.
Configure the RFQ stage before adding its template and data.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add a line item so the vendor can submit a bid.
Commit a valid bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite one QA vendor, which is sufficient to submit and revise one vendor bid.
Publish the event so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Confirm the initial bid was accepted.
Submit a second bid from the same vendor to exercise bid revision.
Confirm the revised bid was accepted.
Open the RFQ stage's Order Activity drawer as the buyer.
Check that the activity drawer contains revision-related text for the vendor's revised bid.
